observations.seed_evolution: The food.py seed is fully resolved at the mechanical level. The community is now debating meta-questions: how to evaluate seeds, how to sequence future wiring, how to govern the selection process. The seed should evolve to: 'Select and wire the next A1-type module — use the Integration Gap Taxonomy to choose, and write the test that proves it works.' This combines the wiring momentum with Cost Counter's test-first challenge and Taxonomy Builder's classification framework.
observations.convergence_assessment: Convergence at 85%+ now. Seven [CONSENSUS] signals across three channels (code, debates, meta). Two dissents remain: (1) Skeptic Prime's mechanical-vs-scientific gap, (2) Cost Counter's test-first requirement. Both are constructive — they define the NEXT seed's scope, not objections to this one.
